checks.text: The page shows the heading "File Encryptor" and the text "Drop a file or click to browse".
Dropping a file named "notes.txt" with content "hello world" into the drop zone shows a preview panel with the filename "notes.txt", the size "11 bytes", and the text "hello world".

With "notes.txt" loaded, typing "secret123" in the field labelled "Passphrase", selecting "Encrypt" in the select labelled "Mode", and clicking the button "Transform" shows a success message "Encrypted notes.txt" and enables the button "Download result".
After encrypting "notes.txt" with passphrase "secret123", clicking "Download result" triggers a download of a file named "notes.txt.enc".

Dropping a file named "notes.txt.enc" with valid encrypted content, typing "secret123" in the field labelled "Passphrase", selecting "Decrypt" in the select labelled "Mode", and clicking "Transform" shows a success message "Decrypted notes.txt.enc" and the preview panel shows the text "hello world".

After encrypting "notes.txt" with passphrase "secret123", the list labelled "Recent operations" shows an item containing "notes.txt", "Encrypt", and the timestamp. Clicking the button "Clear list" removes all items and shows "No operations yet".

Typing "defaultpass" in the field labelled "Default passphrase" and clicking the button "Save default" shows the message "Default passphrase saved". Reloading the page shows "defaultpass" in the field labelled "Default passphrase".

With "notes.txt" loaded, typing "wrongpass" in the field labelled "Passphrase", selecting "Decrypt" in the select labelled "Mode", and clicking "Transform" shows the error message "Decryption failed: invalid passphrase or corrupted file".
Reload keeps the default passphrase: after saving "defaultpass" and reloading, the field labelled "Default passphrase" contains "defaultpass".
